sn35.151:1.1: “Bhikkhus, this holy life is lived without students and without a teacher.
sn35.151:1.2: A bhikkhu who has students and a teacher dwells in suffering, not in comfort.
sn35.151:1.3: A bhikkhu who has no students and no teacher dwells happily, in comfort.
sn35.151:1.4: “And how, bhikkhus, does a bhikkhu who has students and a teacher dwell in suffering, not in comfort?
sn35.151:1.5: Here, bhikkhus, when a bhikkhu has seen a form with the eye, there arise in him evil unwholesome states, memories and intentions connected with the fetters.
sn35.151:1.6: They dwell within him. Since those evil unwholesome states dwell within him,
sn35.151:1.7: he is called ‘one who has students.’
sn35.151:1.8: They assail him. Since evil unwholesome states assail him,
sn35.151:1.9: he is called ‘one who has a teacher.’
sn35.151:2.1: “Further, when a bhikkhu has heard a sound with the ear …
sn35.151:3.1: cognized a mental phenomenon with the mind …
sn35.151:3.6: “It is in this way that a bhikkhu who has students and a teacher dwells in suffering, not in comfort.
sn35.151:4.1: “And how, bhikkhus, does a bhikkhu who has no students and no teacher dwell happily, in comfort?
sn35.151:4.2: Here, bhikkhus, when a bhikkhu has seen a form with the eye, there do not arise in him evil unwholesome states, memories and intentions connected with the fetters.
sn35.151:4.3: They do not dwell within him. Since those evil unwholesome states do not dwell within him,
sn35.151:4.4: he is called ‘one who has no students.’
sn35.151:4.5: They do not assail him. Since evil unwholesome states do not assail him,
sn35.151:4.6: he is called ‘one who has no teacher.’
sn35.151:5.1: “Further, when a bhikkhu has heard a sound with the ear …
sn35.151:6.1: cognized a mental phenomenon with the mind …
sn35.151:6.6: “It is in this way, bhikkhus, that a bhikkhu who has no students and no teacher dwells happily, in comfort.
sn35.151:6.7: “Bhikkhus, this holy life is lived without students and without a teacher.
sn35.151:6.8: A bhikkhu who has students and a teacher dwells in suffering, not in comfort.
sn35.151:6.9: A bhikkhu who has no students and no teacher dwells happily, in comfort.”
